spec.hypothesis: Budget sweep: constrained MCKP at compression ratios 2x/4x/8x (budget=0.5/0.25/0.125). Compare each against uniform baseline at same budget. Qwen2.5-7B, WikiText-2.

experiment_data.notes: FP16 PPL=9.81. 2x(budget=0.5): uniform-8bit=10.10, MCKP=10.66 (delta=-0.56, MCKP worse — loose budget). 4x(budget=0.25): uniform-4bit=15.45, MCKP=11.23 (delta=+4.21, confirmed). 8x(budget=0.125): uniform-2bit=14758.92, MCKP=906.78 (delta=+13852, L0 protection critical). MCKP wins at 4x and 8x. At 2x, uniform 8-bit is sufficient; MCKP's mixed allocation (38x16bit+66x4bit+8x2bit) hurts due to MSE-PPL proxy gap. Story: MCKP advantage grows with compression ratio.
